offer.title: Try with sample data
offer.description: Look around the panel filled with sample data, in a separate company: {name}. It is never listed on the portal, sends no email or SMS, and you can delete it in one click.

preparingHint: This takes a few minutes. You can keep working, or open it now and watch it fill.
readyHint: It is never listed on the portal and sends no email or SMS. Delete it when you are done.
failed: Not all of the sample data could be prepared.
failedHint: You can still open it, or delete it and create a new one.

inSandbox.title: You are in a sample company
inSandbox.description: Everything here is sample data. It is never listed on the portal and sends no email or SMS.
inSandbox.deleteHint: When you are done, delete it from the home page of {name}.

success.title: Sample company created. Its sample data is being prepared.

error.title: The sample company could not be created

delete.confirmDescription: The sample company and all its sample data are deleted for good. Your own company is not touched.

error.title: The sample company could not be deleted
